description: This file defines interfaces and classes for user, order, and tracking services in a delivery backend system, including method implementations for user registration, login, order creation, order status updates, and tracking event management.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class implementing user registration and login functionalities, interfacing with IUserRepository.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: Service class managing order creation, retrieval, and status updates, along with tracking event creation.

classes.name: TrackingService
classes.description: Service class for managing tracking events associated with orders.

classes.name: PackageDetailsRequest
classes.description: Data transfer object for package details used during order creation.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieve a user by their unique identifier.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a new user with name, email, and password.

methods.name: CreateOrder
methods.description: Creates a new delivery order with specified user, origin, destination, and package details.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieve an order by its unique identifier.

methods.name: GetOrdersByUser
methods.description: Get all orders associated with a specific user.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Update the status of an existing order.

methods.name: AddEvent
methods.description: Add a new tracking event for an order.

methods.name: GetTrackingEvents
methods.description: Retrieve all tracking events for a specific order.
